prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1074; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact came. The force threw me against the steering wheel and the door, and I felt sharp pain in my left wrist right away. I was taken to an emergency room, where X-rays showed a fracture, and I have been wearing a cast since then. I have given the same description of what happened to the adjuster, to the police officer on scene, and to the medical staff, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this statement so my claim can be reviewed.
